lines.say: Why does your heart keep racing after you stop?
Your workout isn't over for your body yet.
During hard exercise, your muscles use up their fast energy and oxygen stores.
After you stop, they need extra oxygen to refill them, so your heart keeps pumping.
It's also moving heat out and clearing waste from your muscles.
So your heart rate drops fast at first, then slowly.
The fitter you get, the faster it drops.
Doctors even use how fast it falls in the first minute as a sign of heart health.
